odc_type: incorrect type inference for templatized methods
observation_summary: The compiler reports spurious type mismatch warnings (JSC_TYPE_MISMATCH) when a method uses a @template annotation.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the Closure Compiler's type inference engine incorrectly associates a template parameter defined on a method with the enclosing class's template parameters. When a method has its own @template annotation, the compiler erroneously attempts to infer the class-level template type from the method's usage, leading to spurious type mismatch warnings. This is evidenced by the failing tests where valid code is flagged as having type mismatches because the compiler incorrectly resolves the template types.
